mail.layout.tagline: Perch keeps your data on your own devices and in sync between them.
mail.verify-email.subject: Confirm your email for Perch
mail.verify-email.preview: One step left: confirm your email to sign in to Perch.
mail.verify-email.heading: Confirm your email
mail.verify-email.body: Open this link to confirm {email} and sign in to your new Perch account:
mail.verify-email.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser:
mail.verify-email.expiry: The link works for 24 hours. You can ask for a new one on the sign-in page.
mail.verify-email.ignore: If you did not create a Perch account, ignore this mail: nothing happens without the link.
mail.verify-email.reason: You got this mail because this address was used to create a Perch account.
mail.reset-password.subject: Set a new password for Perch
mail.reset-password.preview: Open the link to choose a new password for your Perch account.
mail.reset-password.heading: Set a new password
mail.reset-password.body: A new password was asked for the Perch account of {email}. Open this link to choose it:
mail.reset-password.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser:
mail.reset-password.expiry: The link works for one hour, and only the newest link you asked for works. You can ask for a new one on the sign-in page.
mail.reset-password.ignore: If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this mail: your password stays as it is.
mail.reset-password.reason: You got this mail because a new password was asked for the Perch account of this address.
mail.confirm-email.subject: Confirm your new email for Perch
mail.confirm-email.preview: One step left: confirm your new email to sign in to Perch with it.
mail.confirm-email.heading: Confirm your new email
mail.confirm-email.body: Open this link to make {email} the email of your Perch account. From then on, you sign in with it:
mail.confirm-email.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser:
mail.confirm-email.expiry: The link works for 24 hours, and only the newest link you asked for works.
mail.confirm-email.ignore: If you did not ask for this change, ignore this mail: the account keeps its email.
mail.confirm-email.reason: You got this mail because this address was given as the new email of a Perch account.
mail.password-changed.subject: Your Perch password was changed
mail.password-changed.preview: The password of your Perch account was just changed.
mail.password-changed.heading: Your password was changed
mail.password-changed.body: The password of the Perch account of {email} was just changed. If it wasn't you, set a new password now:
mail.password-changed.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser:
mail.password-changed.done: If it was you, there is nothing to do.
mail.password-changed.reason: You got this mail because the password of the Perch account of this address was changed.
mail.email-changed.subject: Your Perch account has a new email
mail.email-changed.preview: This address is no longer the email of your Perch account.
mail.email-changed.heading: Your email was changed
mail.email-changed.body: {email} is no longer the email of your Perch account: from now on, the account signs in with its new email.
mail.email-changed.stranger: If you did not change it, someone else may know your password. Whoever runs this Perch can help you get the account back.
mail.email-changed.reason: You got this mail because this address was the email of a Perch account.
